newsitem.title: FRANCE: Banque Rivaud shareholders set capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Banque Rivaud shareholders set capital increase.

text.p: Banque Rivaud, which has linked up with British Airways in a bid to take over ailing Air Liberte, said on Monday its shareholders had agreed to quadruple the capital to 800 million francs.
It said the 600 million franc capital increase would be carried out before the end of the year, boosting equity to 1.09 billion francs.
"The equity, after provisions relating mainly to the Air Liberte case, will ensure prudent bank ratios," Banque Rivaud said in a statement.
As part of the joint bid, Banque Rivaud and BA would cover the costs of Air Liberte since it filed for receivership on September 26.
Banque Rivaud, whose shareholders include chairman Vincent Bollore, was Air Liberte's biggest shareholder prior to the airline's filing for receivership.
If the joint bid succeeds, it would take 30 percent, leaving BA in control of Air Liberte with 70 percent.
